libs.note: BH-8067: the fleet's own record of each fleet-owned PR (D1 table pr_records, PUT/GET /api/pr-records). pr_record_put writes it; pr_record_get reads it and calls GitHub (one REST GET of the PR) only when the record does not know a requested field, or is older than PR_RECORD_MAX_AGE_S. Then it writes what it read into the record. In C0 the only writer is the PR open in bin/lib/gh-pr-create.sh and no lane reads the record yet. BH-8271: bin/orphan-reconcile.sh reads PR_RECORD_MAX_AGE_S (through pr_record_max_age) as the max age of its stored open-PR list, and logs PRR_MISS <repo>#list why=<no-row|stale> per GitHub list read. Log: logs/pr-record.log (one line per GitHub read).

knobs.zero_means: every pr_record_get reads GitHub; the record is written but never trusted
knobs.note: The max age of a record pr_record_get serves without a GitHub read: the worker's now minus the record's last write (any source). An older record is re-read from GitHub once and refreshed. Read through lane_knob (libs scope) when the caller has it, else as ${PR_RECORD_MAX_AGE_S:-900}; a value that is not a non-negative integer is 900 and one logs/pr-record.log line names it.
